title: Vector Playground
summary: Drag two arrows and watch their sum, difference, and scaled relatives appear in real time.

title: Basis Explorer
summary: Change a basis and see how the same point gets new coordinates without moving.

title: Linear Map Theater
summary: Push a grid through a 2×2 matrix and watch straight lines stay straight.

title: Inner Product Lab
summary: Explore length, angle, projection, and orthogonality with two draggable arrows.

title: Determinant Volume
summary: See how a matrix stretches, squashes, or flips area and volume.

title: Eigenvector Dance
summary: Watch which directions refuse to turn when a matrix acts over and over.

title: Bilinear Form Lab
summary: Play with a symmetric bilinear form and watch its level curves change shape.

title: Wedge Areas
summary: Explore oriented parallelograms, cross products, and the first glimpse of exterior algebra.

title: Tensor Product Builder
summary: Combine two vectors and see a whole grid of new basis elements appear.

title: Component Transformer
summary: Rotate the coordinate frame and watch tensor components change while the geometry stays still.

title: Tensor Applications
summary: See a stress ellipsoid and a diffusion field react to changing tensor components.

title: Forms and Fields
summary: Move through a plane and watch 1-forms and 2-forms measure directions and areas.
